decisionOwner: PSDC Compute Fabric Working Group; accountable maintainer RedjiJB until delegation
governingRefs: ADR-0031 hybrid operational database and ledger

candidates.licenseEvidence: PostgreSQL License: https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/ ; pg MIT: package-lock.json entry for pg 8.23.1 and https://github.com/brianc/node-postgres/blob/master/LICENSE
candidates.fit: One local transaction can commit a workload record and outbox event; PostgreSQL row locking supports multiple queue consumers. The pg client keeps all transaction statements on one connection.
candidates.limitations: This development prototype has no approved migration/rollback plan, broker, idempotent downstream consumer, backup/restore, or production topology. The PostgreSQL server version is the local WSL test version, not a deployment pin.

candidates.licenseEvidence: SQLite public-domain statement: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html ; jurisdiction and contribution implications not reviewed
candidates.fit: An embedded database could simplify a single-process offline development profile and still offer atomic local transactions.
candidates.limitations: SQLite serializes writers; multi-process claim and recovery behavior for the institutional control plane has not been prototyped or benchmarked. It is not an approved substitute.

selection.rationale: Provisional development-profile adapter, not an accepted production dependency: the existing repository prototype and local synthetic test exercise transactional workload/outbox behavior without implementing a database engine or ledger.

upstreamProvides: transactional storage, unique constraints and row locking
PostgreSQL client pooling and per-connection transaction operations
psdcOwns: institution-scoped request admission and idempotency semantics
event identity, claim fencing and consumer deduplication contract
retention, privacy classification, deployment topology and recovery policy
institutional credit and ledger settlement authority
excluded: protected student data in the development profile
database-as-authority for ledger settlement or institutional policy

evidence.method: Node test suite against disposable WSL PostgreSQL 16.15; synthetic identities and digests
evidence.limitations: Six tests passed locally; no CI, broker, independent consumer, backup/restore, or institution deployment was exercised. The test database and role were removed.

evidence.method: Review of official PostgreSQL SELECT documentation and node-postgres transaction guidance
evidence.limitations: Upstream documentation supports the selected mechanisms; it does not establish PSDC conformance or operational readiness.

maintenance.owner: RedjiJB until a second maintainer is appointed
maintenance.updatePlan: Pin the server image and pg lockfile in a reviewed development profile; track upstream security fixes and run migration/retry regression tests before upgrades.
maintenance.replacementTrigger: Revisit if concurrent-claim behavior, operational burden, license review or institution deployment requirements invalidate the adapter.
maintenance.patchBudget: No upstream fork or patch is proposed; PSDC owns only the bounded store and dispatcher adapter.
